prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production fish sprite atlas for the Japanese retro fishing game 星降る湖. Create ONE original transparent PNG sprite sheet of the Japanese bagrid catfish ギギ (Tachysurus nudiceps), with EXACTLY eight isolated poses arranged in a clean FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid. Landscape 3:2 sheet, transparent alpha background, no text, no borders, no scenery, no glow, no shadows detached from the fish. All eight poses depict the SAME adult individual, consistent olive brown charcoal back, warm golden brown flanks, pale cream belly, smooth scaleless skin, small normal black eyes, a pointed dorsal fin, a separate low adipose fin, broad pectoral fins, EIGHT slender barbels around a broad mouth, distinctly forked tail (not a rounded eel or ordinary namazu tail). Match high quality detailed 16-bit Japanese fishing RPG sprite artwork: crisp deliberate pixel clusters and fine pixel texture, warm natural colours, readable silhouette, anatomically recognizable. No caricature, no anthropomorphism. The head is proportionally broader than a minnow and narrower than a giant monster. All fins, forked tails and barbel tips fully inside their cell with generous transparent gaps. Row one left to right: full side view head RIGHT; head right three-quarter slight turn toward viewer; head right strongly foreshortened quarter view; exact frontal head-on symmetrical view showing the whiskers. Row two left to right: strongly foreshortened quarter view head LEFT; three-quarter head left; full side view head LEFT; full side view head RIGHT with mouth slightly open. Important: each fish is one complete coherent body, and each pose's scale corresponds to the SAME individual rather than zooming the frontal pose up. The first and seventh pure side views should be longest. Keep all eight cells separated and similarly aligned vertically so they can be cropped into independent animation frames.
